content: hotkey_manager 0.4.0 (leanflutter, Nov 2026, Flutter 3.50/Dart 3.14, nativeapi): system-wide hotkeys Win/macOS/Linux. Linux Wayland requires org.freedesktop.portal.GlobalShortcuts provider (KDE Plasma 6 has it) + .desktop file matching GTK app id; needs a working portal, else PlatformException. Windows uses RegisterHotKey path — reliable. dicta already has evdev/KWin-adapter hotkeys on Linux.
